messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Oct 18, 2020, Tom Wang wrote:
>
>I just got Amber20 software, try to install it.
>I saw so many warning like these( see below). a lot of them, I just listed few.
>What should be done to fix it?
I've already answered this privately, but for the rest on the list:
compiler warnings are expected.  The "maybe-unitialized" type sound bad,
but most are innocuous.  You can adjust your compiler flags to silence
these  :-)
...dac
